Designed as a smaller wide-body airliner than earlier aircraft such as the 747, the 767 has seating capacity for 181 to 375 people, and a design range of 3850 to , depending on variant. Workers’ right to access restroom | Workers' right to access restroom refers to the rights of employees to take a break when they need to use the bathroom.
